title: The Time Machine
description: A Victorian inventor builds a machine that moves through time, rides it to the year 802,701 and finds two descendants of humanity: the childlike Eloi who live in the ruins above and the Morlocks who tend machines below and come up at night.

cover.alt: The White Sphinx in the garden of the year 802,701
cover.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The fourth dimension
elements.text: After dinner at his house in Richmond, the Time Traveller argues that time is a dimension like the other three, then sends a small model machine into the future in front of his guests.

metadata.source_quote: There is no difference between Time and any of the three dimensions of Space except that our consciousness moves along it.

image.alt: The Time Traveller's guests watch the model machine vanish
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Traveller returns
elements.text: A week later he limps in late to dinner, dusty, cut and starving, asks for mutton, and begins his story.

metadata.source_quote: Save me some of that mutton.

image.alt: The Time Traveller returns, dishevelled, to dinner
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The journey
elements.text: Night and day flicker past, the sun becomes a band of fire, and he stops in a hailstorm beside a white sphinx.

metadata.source_quote: I saw the sun hopping swiftly across the sky, leaping it every minute, and every minute marking a day.

image.alt: Travelling: days flicker past and the sun streaks across the sky
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Eloi
elements.text: Small, beautiful people garland him with flowers, eat only fruit, live together in great ruined halls and lose interest in everything within minutes.

image.alt: The Eloi garland the Time Traveller with flowers
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The machine is gone
elements.text: His Time Machine has vanished from the lawn: dragged inside the bronze doors of the sphinx's pedestal.

image.alt: The White Sphinx in the garden of the year 802,701
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Weena
elements.text: He saves a drowning Eloi woman, Weena, whom nobody else tried to help. She follows him everywhere and is terrified of the dark.

metadata.source_quote: She was exactly like a child.

image.alt: The Time Traveller saves Weena from the river
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The wells
elements.text: White ape-like figures run in the moonlight. He finds round wells with a throb of machinery below, and climbs down one.

image.alt: The wells that lead down to the Morlocks
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Underground
elements.text: In the tunnels pale-eyed Morlocks crowd round him; only his matches hold them off. He sees meat on a table and understands.

metadata.source_quote: those pale, chinless faces and great, lidless, pinkish-grey eyes!

image.alt: Underground, the Time Traveller holds off the Morlocks with a match
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Palace of Green Porcelain
elements.text: With Weena he explores a ruined museum of fossils and machines, finds camphor and more matches, and takes an iron lever as a weapon.

image.alt: The Palace of Green Porcelain, a ruined museum
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Fire in the forest
elements.text: Caught in the forest at night, he lights a fire to scare the Morlocks; it becomes a blaze, and in the struggle Weena is lost.

image.alt: The fire in the forest, where Weena is lost
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The trap of the sphinx
elements.text: The pedestal doors stand open; he walks in, the Morlocks close the trap, and he escapes on the machine into the future.

image.alt: The White Sphinx in the garden of the year 802,701
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The terminal beach
elements.text: Millions of years on, under a swollen red sun, giant crabs crawl on a dying shore; further on, only darkness and cold.

metadata.source_quote: At last, more than thirty million years hence, the huge red-hot dome of the sun had come to obscure nearly a tenth part of the darkling heavens.

image.alt: The terminal beach under the dying red sun
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Gone again
elements.text: He leaves with a camera to bring back proof and never returns. The narrator keeps two white flowers Weena gave him.

metadata.source_quote: The Time Traveller vanished three years ago.

image.alt: Two strange white flowers, Weena's gift
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Time Traveller
elements.text: An inventor and lecturer in Richmond, eloquent and impatient, who never gives his name; he narrates most of the book to his dinner guests.

metadata.source_quote: The Time Traveller (for so it will be convenient to speak of him) was expounding a recondite matter to us.

image.alt: Travelling: days flicker past and the sun streaks across the sky
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Weena
elements.text: A small Eloi woman whom he saves from the river. Childlike and loyal, she is the one being in the future he cares for.

image.alt: The Time Traveller saves Weena from the river
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Eloi
elements.text: The surface people of 802,701: delicate, four feet tall, curly-haired, idle and incurious, and in fear of the night.

metadata.source_quote: The Eloi, like the Carlovignan kings, had decayed to a mere beautiful futility.

image.alt: The Eloi garland the Time Traveller with flowers
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Morlocks
elements.text: The underground people: pale, ape-like, nocturnal and blinded by light, who keep the machines running and feed on the Eloi.

image.alt: Underground, the Time Traveller holds off the Morlocks with a match
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The dinner guests
elements.text: The Medical Man, the Psychologist, the Provincial Mayor, the argumentative red-haired Filby, the Editor and the narrator, who doubt everything.

image.alt: The Time Traveller's guests watch the model machine vanish
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The house in Richmond
elements.text: The Traveller's smoking room and laboratory by the Thames, where the story is told after dinner.

image.alt: The Time Traveller's guests watch the model machine vanish
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The White Sphinx
elements.text: A huge winged sphinx of white marble on a bronze pedestal, which hides the way into the Morlock world.

metadata.source_quote: It was of white marble, in shape something like a winged sphinx

image.alt: The White Sphinx in the garden of the year 802,701
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The wells and the Underworld
elements.text: Round shafts with domed tops across the countryside, leading down to tunnels and the hum of machines.

image.alt: The wells that lead down to the Morlocks
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Palace of Green Porcelain
elements.text: A ruined museum full of fossils, dead machines and rotted books, a monument to everything humans once knew.

image.alt: The Palace of Green Porcelain, a ruined museum
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The terminal beach
elements.text: A red shore under a dying sun where the last life on Earth crawls by a salt sea.

image.alt: The terminal beach under the dying red sun
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The Time Machine
elements.text: A glittering frame of brass, ivory and quartz with a saddle and two levers, one for the future and one for the past.

metadata.source_quote: an eddy of faintly glittering brass and ivory

image.alt: Travelling: days flicker past and the sun streaks across the sky
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: The year 802,701
elements.text: The date on the machine's dials when he stops: the Thames moved a mile, England one garden of ruins and flowers.

metadata.source_quote: Eight Hundred and Two Thousand Seven Hundred and One, A.D.

image.alt: The Eloi garland the Time Traveller with flowers
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Class becomes species
elements.text: Wells extrapolates the Victorian division between capitalists and labourers until they stop being one species.

metadata.source_quote: above ground you must have the Haves, pursuing pleasure and comfort and beauty, and below ground the Have-nots

image.alt: The wells that lead down to the Morlocks
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Ease breeds weakness
elements.text: Intelligence survives only while it is needed. A humanity with no dangers left grows lovely, weak and stupid.

metadata.source_quote: intellectual versatility is the compensation for change, danger, and trouble.

image.alt: The Eloi garland the Time Traveller with flowers
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Entropy and the end
elements.text: Beyond the Eloi, the Traveller watches the solar system run down: the cosmic version of the same decline.

image.alt: The terminal beach under the dying red sun
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Small tenderness
elements.text: Weena's loyalty and her flowers are the only answer the book gives to deep time.

metadata.source_quote: gratitude and a mutual tenderness still lived on in the heart of man.

image.alt: Two strange white flowers, Weena's gift
image.credit: Illustration made with gpt-image-2 for ConteXtube.

elements.title: Communism
elements.text: On first seeing the Eloi living together without houses or families, the Traveller decides he has found a communist future, and is wrong.

elements.title: The Metropolitan Railway
elements.text: The Traveller cites London's underground railway as proof that work was already being pushed below ground in his own day.

elements.title: Darwin and T. H. Huxley
elements.text: Wells studied biology under Huxley, 'Darwin's bulldog'. Readers may see The Time Machine as natural selection told as a story, with no promise of progress.

elements.title: Benjamin Disraeli's Two Nations (Sybil, 1845)
elements.text: Disraeli described rich and poor as two nations 'between whom there is no intercourse and no sympathy'. Readers may see the Eloi and the Morlocks as that phrase taken literally.

elements.title: Kelvin and the heat death of the universe
elements.text: Victorian physics predicted a cooling sun and a universe running down. Readers may find that prediction on the terminal beach.

elements.title: The Lotus-Eaters (Homer, Odyssey)
elements.text: Sailors who eat the lotus forget home and want only to stay. Readers may think of the Eloi, who eat fruit, play and forget.

elements.title: The Time Machine (George Pal, 1960)
elements.text: The film with Rod Taylor and its red-plush, brass-dialled machine set how most people picture the story.

elements.title: Doctor Who (1963–)
elements.text: A time traveller in a machine larger inside than out, who keeps arriving in distant futures to find humanity changed. Readers may see Wells's Traveller as the Doctor's grandfather.

elements.title: Back to the Future (1985)
elements.text: A teenager and an eccentric inventor with a time machine built into a car. Readers may hear Wells's dinner party in Doc Brown's demonstration with a dog in the DeLorean.

elements.title: Planet of the Apes (1968)
elements.text: An astronaut lands on a future Earth where humans are mute animals and finds a ruined landmark that reveals where he is. Readers may think of the Palace of Green Porcelain and humanity's fall.

elements.title: The Matrix (1999)
elements.text: Machines farm sleeping humans for energy. Readers may recognise the Morlocks' herding of the Eloi as the same nightmare: comfort as captivity.

elements.title: WALL-E (2008)
elements.text: Humans drift in a cruise ship in space, so served by machines that they can no longer walk. Readers may see them as Eloi in the making.

elements.title: The Morlocks of Marvel's X-Men
elements.text: A community of outcast mutants living in tunnels under New York, named after Wells's underground race. Readers of comics may meet the word there first.
